Whom God has put forward as the sign of his mercy
through faith
by his blood
to make clear his righteousness when
in his pity
God let the sins of earlier times go without punishment;
所以我们看定了：人称义是因着信，
不在乎遵行律法。
所以我們看定了：人稱義是因着信，
不在乎遵行律法。
We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

then

经上说甚么呢？说：「亚伯拉罕信神，
这就算为他的义。」
經上說甚麼呢？說：「亞伯拉罕信神，
這就算為他的義。」
For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God
and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

這就算為他的義。」
For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God
and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
But what does it say in the holy Writings? And Abraham had faith in God
and it was put to his account as righteousness.
惟有不作工的，只信称罪人为义的神，
他的信就算为义。
惟有不作工的，只信稱罪人為義的神，
他的信就算為義。
But to him who doesn’t work
but believes in him who justifies the ungodly
his faith is accounted for righteousness.

But to him who without working has faith in him who gives righteousness to the evil-doer
his faith is put to his account as righteousness.

whose sins are covered.

whose sins are covered.
Happy are those who have forgiveness for their wrongdoing
and whose sins are covered.

主不算為有罪的，這人是有福的。

复活，是为叫我们称义。
耶穌被交給人，是為我們的過犯；
復活，是為叫我們稱義。
who was delivered up for our trespasses
and was raised for our justification.

Who was put to death for our evil-doing
and came to life again so that we might have righteousness.

我們既因信稱義，就藉着我們的主耶穌基督得與神相和。
Being therefore justified by faith
we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

For which reason
because we have righteousness through faith

But God commends his own love toward us
in that while we were yet sinners
Christ died for us.
